# Lab 18.9: Lifecycle Rules & Retention Policy

## What We Are Going to Do
Add lifecycle rules to a bucket, set a retention policy, use an object hold, and lock a short policy to see why locking is permanent.

## Steps

1. **Create a bucket and add lifecycle rules.** Create `lifecycle.json`:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • JSON
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">{
  "rule": [
    {"action": {"type": "SetStorageClass", "storageClass": "COLDLINE"},
     "condition": {"age": 90}},
    {"action": {"type": "Delete"},
     "condition": {"age": 365}}
  ]
}</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage buckets create gs://$PROJECT_ID-retain --location=us-central1
gcloud storage buckets update gs://$PROJECT_ID-retain --lifecycle-file=lifecycle.json
gcloud storage buckets describe gs://$PROJECT_ID-retain --format="yaml(lifecycle_config)"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Add a retention policy of 2 minutes.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage buckets update gs://$PROJECT_ID-retain --retention-period=120s
echo "record" | gcloud storage cp - gs://$PROJECT_ID-retain/record.txt
gcloud storage rm gs://$PROJECT_ID-retain/record.txt</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Delete fails until the object is 2 minutes old.

3. **Use an object hold.** A hold blocks deletion with no time limit, for example during a legal case.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">echo "evidence" | gcloud storage cp - gs://$PROJECT_ID-retain/evidence.txt
gcloud storage objects update gs://$PROJECT_ID-retain/evidence.txt --temporary-hold
gcloud storage rm gs://$PROJECT_ID-retain/evidence.txt
gcloud storage objects update gs://$PROJECT_ID-retain/evidence.txt --no-temporary-hold</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Lock the policy.** This cannot be undone. We lock only a 2-minute period.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage buckets update gs://$PROJECT_ID-retain --lock-retention-period</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Try to change it.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage buckets update gs://$PROJECT_ID-retain --clear-retention-period
gcloud storage buckets update gs://$PROJECT_ID-retain --retention-period=60s</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Both fail. A locked period can only be increased.

6. **Clean up.** Wait 2 minutes after the last upload, then:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage rm --recursive gs://$PROJECT_ID-retain</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Lifecycle | Coldline at 90 days, delete at 365 |
| Retention | Objects cannot be deleted early |
| Hold | Blocks deletion until released |
| Locked policy | Cannot be removed or shortened |
